newsitem.title: CANADA: Crown Life settles U.S. class action.
newsitem.headline: Crown Life settles U.S. class action.

text.p: Crown Life Insurance Co said on Thursday it settled a U.S. class action suit for an estimated US$27 million with policy owners who were sold "vanishing premium" policies.
The company said the settlement would be charged to surplus and would not affect 1996 net income.
The settlement was aimed at avoiding uncertainties, costs and delays in the suit that has also hit up to 100 other insurance companies in the United States, Crown Life said.

"Vanishing premium" policies were billed as policies that required a limited number of payments and that would accumulate large cash values. But some of the suits alleged that additional premium payments were required to keep the policies current.

Crown Life also believed the settlement compares favorably to other settlements reached in the industry. Details of the settlement were to be mailed to participating policy holders in the next two weeks.
